headline: Capitulation wash-out — bounce setup
detail: Aggregate SOPR capitulation (z≤−1.5) after a deep drop — reactive bounce setup. BTC $94,504.

edge: Capitulation wash-out (SOPR). REACTIVE — fires AFTER a deep drop and leads the BOUNCE by ~2d; it is NOT a pre-emptive bottom call.
edge_zh: 投降式洗盘（SOPR）。反应式 — 在大幅下跌之后触发，领先反弹约 2 天；并非提前抄底信号。

headline: Down-impulse pressure: vol-of-vol jolt
detail: DVOL intraday-range spike (z≥2) — the options market is repricing risk. BTC $97,677.
headline_zh: 下行脉冲压力：波动率跳升
detail_zh: DVOL 日内振幅骤升（z≥2）— 期权市场正在重新定价风险。 BTC $97,677.
edge: Forward de-risk window from a verified LEADING precursor cross (impulse radar). Holdout-validated, leak-free; act early — the edge decays in ~2-4 days. BLIND to slow/options-calm flushes (e.g. it did NOT lead the 2026-06-24 cascade).
edge_zh: 来自经验证的领先前兆突破的前瞻减仓窗口（脉冲雷达）。已通过留出样本、无前视；应尽早行动 — 优势在约 2-4 天内衰减。对缓慢/期权平静式下跌无效（例如未能领先 2026-06-24 的下跌）。

headline: OI crowding building — de-risk context
detail: Open interest crossed into elevated (funding-independent). Leverage fuel loading, not a crash call. BTC $100,624.
headline_zh: 持仓拥挤升高 — 减仓背景
detail_zh: 未平仓合约升至偏高（与资金费率无关）。杠杆燃料堆积，并非下跌信号。 BTC $100,624.
edge: OI-crowding de-risk nudge — funding-INDEPENDENT (breaks the cascade AND-gate). LOW-CONVICTION: open interest is anti-predictive standalone (measured lift ~0.36) — a 'fuel building' context flag, not a validated crash call.
edge_zh: 持仓拥挤减仓提示 — 与资金费率无关（突破连环清算的与门）。低信心：未平仓合约单独使用为反向指标（实测 lift 约 0.36）— 仅为“燃料堆积”背景标记，而非经验证的下跌信号。

edge: Forward de-risk window from a verified LEADING precursor cross (impulse radar). Holdout-validated, leak-free; act early — the edge decays in ~2-4 days. BLIND to slow/options-calm flushes (e.g. it did NOT lead the 2026-06-24 cascade).

headline: OI crowding building — de-risk context

edge: OI-crowding de-risk nudge — funding-INDEPENDENT (breaks the cascade AND-gate). LOW-CONVICTION: open interest is anti-predictive standalone (measured lift ~0.36) — a 'fuel building' context flag, not a validated crash call.

edge_zh: 投降式洗盘（SOPR）。反应式 — 在大幅下跌之后触发，领先反弹约 2 天；并非提前抄底信号。

headline: Down-impulse pressure: vol-of-vol jolt
detail: DVOL intraday-range spike (z≥2) — the options market is repricing risk. BTC $30,078.
headline_zh: 下行脉冲压力：波动率跳升
detail_zh: DVOL 日内振幅骤升（z≥2）— 期权市场正在重新定价风险。 BTC $30,078.
edge: Forward de-risk window from a verified LEADING precursor cross (impulse radar). Holdout-validated, leak-free; act early — the edge decays in ~2-4 days. BLIND to slow/options-calm flushes (e.g. it did NOT lead the 2026-06-24 cascade).
edge_zh: 来自经验证的领先前兆突破的前瞻减仓窗口（脉冲雷达）。已通过留出样本、无前视；应尽早行动 — 优势在约 2-4 天内衰减。对缓慢/期权平静式下跌无效（例如未能领先 2026-06-24 的下跌）。

headline: Capitulation wash-out — bounce setup
detail: Aggregate SOPR capitulation (z≤−1.5) after a deep drop — reactive bounce setup. BTC $30,078.
headline_zh: 投降式洗盘 — 反弹布局
detail_zh: 深跌之后总体 SOPR 投降（z≤−1.5）— 反应式反弹布局。 BTC $30,078.
edge: Capitulation wash-out (SOPR). REACTIVE — fires AFTER a deep drop and leads the BOUNCE by ~2d; it is NOT a pre-emptive bottom call.
edge_zh: 投降式洗盘（SOPR）。反应式 — 在大幅下跌之后触发，领先反弹约 2 天；并非提前抄底信号。

headline: Capitulation wash-out — bounce setup
detail: Aggregate SOPR capitulation (z≤−1.5) after a deep drop — reactive bounce setup. BTC $178.
headline_zh: 投降式洗盘 — 反弹布局
detail_zh: 深跌之后总体 SOPR 投降（z≤−1.5）— 反应式反弹布局。 BTC $178.
edge: Capitulation wash-out (SOPR). REACTIVE — fires AFTER a deep drop and leads the BOUNCE by ~2d; it is NOT a pre-emptive bottom call.
edge_zh: 投降式洗盘（SOPR）。反应式 — 在大幅下跌之后触发，领先反弹约 2 天；并非提前抄底信号。
